mapped_plan_m.guess: Measured on the mapped outline in the 13 degree frame: stair foot to north edge, west to east.

spherical_method.value: All twenty half sails use sampled sections of the common 75.2 m sphere. Locations and trims are estimates; loft chords, finite wall thickness and fused tips approximate the sphere for printing.

alignment.guess: Origin and 13 degree peninsula bearing estimated from OSM anchors; x crosses peninsula, y points north along it.

roof_groups.value: Western Concert Hall and eastern Joan Sutherland Theatre each have three ascending north-facing sails and one south-facing return; separate southwest Bennelong has two opposing sails.
roof_groups.guess: Individual map anchors and slightly differing hall bearings approximate source plan and photographs, not a measured survey.

plinth.guess: The mapped building is 170.5 x 114.2 m; the published 183 x 118 m is a wider count, which this base carries. Broadwalk envelope estimated outside simplified podium, maximum width 118 m and y -91 to 92 give published 183 m length. Rounded northern rear approximated by polygon; nominal 2 to 5 m skirt adjusted near indented coast.

value.guess: Digitized OSM outline simplified in the estimated 13 degree frame; lower terrace 0 to 3.2 m is a photo estimate.
Upper terrace face moved behind the monumental south stair at y -58; 12.5 m deck estimated from photographs. Lower terrace overlaps by 0.4 m.
Estimated separate southwest deck under both restaurant shells, beside the head of the stair; it laps the upper podium and its elevations are chosen for attached shell feet.

75.2 m sphere sampled at horizontal rows through estimated foot, apex and lateral toe anchors. Larger local-y sphere center chosen; spherical toe-to-tip arc trims the mouth. Plan anchors, widths, toe run, 12.1 m foot and all roof heights except 67.4 m maximum are OSM/photo estimates. Five overlapping chord strips approximate each curved half; 1.45 m minimum slice thickness grows with slope, common 1.5 m tips and seam overlap serve nominal 190 mm FDM. Each foot runs straight down from its 14.1 m row into the 12.5 m podium. Strip interpolation and finite thickness are modeled approximations, not surveyed shell surfaces.
